attacks.name: Lightning Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

fut20-1.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

attacks.name: Make the Assist
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

fut20-2.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

attacks.name: Tenacious Defense
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

fut20-3.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

attacks.name: Fiery Dribbling
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

fut20-4.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

attacks.name: Spectacular Save
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

fut20-5.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
